claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. Let L(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee.leading. Let h(n)=n^exponent*(log2 n)^log_exponent*(log2 log2 n)^loglog_exponent with the exact parameters in guarantee.remainder. There exist a fixed real K>0 and N such that C_B2(f_n)>=L(n)-K*h(n) for every integer n>=N. K is existential, not a specified coefficient. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"The single total deterministic certificate-free language in family.py and proof.md. For N>=2 set L=floor(log2 N), J=ceil(log2(L+2)), k=floor(2^10000*L^25/J); k>N or failed exact metadata shapes return zero. Set m=floor(k/(2^300*L^2)), h=pow2ceil(2^200*L^2), ell=2^500*L^4, E=2^200*L^2; use the supplied degree-64 orbit short extractor, indexed alternating extraction and monotone polynomial-graph resilient disperser. All actual input bits are payload; every field choice is uniform. There is no advice, witness input or field-polynomial prefix, and the runtime is one fixed polynomial with an enormous degree.","guarantee":{"kind":"eventual_lower_bound","leading":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"remainder":{"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"kind":"big_o","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"25"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"-1"}}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"For this one fixed total uniform language in P, hence NP with empty witnesses, there exist fixed K>0 and N0 such that C_B2(F_N)>=4N-K*(log2 N)^25/(log2 log2 N) for every integer actual length N>=N0 in the full pinned B2 model. The proof supplies affine dispersal at the exact dimension k in the family definition and applies the complete kernel 4N-8(d+1). All material component and borderline fixed-factor accounting arguments are supplied. The same complete guarantee implies the joint finite projection (4,1).","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v2"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact roots, capped powers, field extension arithmetic and primitive order, orbit polynomial linearity, folded affine rank, polynomial graph intersections, truncated-cube covariance and Bonferroni identities; actual small-length zero guards only. No nontrivial asymptotic family evaluation or certification of universal claims.
